purpose: Teach: ゲーテ/プリンセス/モナコ/ボリビア/シオン/有楽町/三鷹/ダーリン

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、世界史でゲーテ習ったろ?
lines.en: Riku, you learned about Goethe in world history, didn't you?
lines.style: Playful interrogation, light challenge. Quick clip on each name. Testing him. Eyes bright with mischief.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、プリンセスの映画ハマってたな、桜
lines.en: You were totally into that princess movie, Sakura.
lines.style: Wry deflection, half-smile in the voice. Turning it back on her before she lands another hit. Casual but pointed.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、社会でモナコ習ったろ?
lines.en: Riku, you learned about Monaco in social studies, didn't you?
lines.style: Same rhythm as before — quick, bright, insistent. Closing in. Not letting him off the hook.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、家族でボリビア旅行行ったろ?桜
lines.en: Your family went to Bolivia, didn't they, Sakura.
lines.style: Matching her tempo now. Trading shots back. Still cool on the surface but there's warmth underneath the teasing.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、宗教でシオン習ったろ?
lines.en: Riku, you learned about Zion in religion class, didn't you?
lines.style: Relentless, bright attack. She's circling now. The questions are getting more specific, more knowing.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、有楽町でデートしたな、桜
lines.en: You took your girlfriend on a date in Yurakucho, didn't you, Sakura.
lines.style: Direct hit. Softer voice suddenly — not mocking, but intimate. He knows something now. The teasing just turned real.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、三鷹ジブリ美術館行ったろ?
lines.en: Riku, you went to the Ghibli Museum in Mitaka, didn't you?
lines.style: Slightly deflated but pushing through. She felt that last one. Trying to land her own blow back, but there's less bite.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、彼女をダーリン呼びしてたな、桜
lines.en: You called your girlfriend "darling," didn't you, Sakura.
lines.style: Quiet, warm, almost tender. Not mean. He's not trying to win anymore — he's just... saying it. Looking at her.
